propositions: Capability decisions currently string-match provider names, so Bedrock-hosted Claude silently loses prompt caching and takes the wrong structured-output path.
Replace provider-name string matching with reads of pydantic-ai's ModelProfile capability record plus a rebar-side override layer, in a new leaf module capabilities.py.

capabilities_for() must accept either a model object exposing .profile or a lazy provider-qualified model string, resolving the string via a single _PROFILE_RESOLVERS registry without constructing the vendor provider or importing its SDK.

prompt_cache_style must be derived from profile capability field presence (bedrock_supports_prompt_caching), not from isinstance(BedrockModelProfile), because that class requires botocore/boto3 which is absent in CI and breaks the stdlib-only import rebar.llm contract.

An ordered (predicate, overrides) table forces Claude on both direct-Anthropic and Bedrock hosts to native_structured_output=False, preserving PromptedOutput; groq is a disclosed behavior change to PromptedOutput.

A model with missing/unrecognized profile degrades to a conservative record (native_structured_output=False, prompt_cache_style=none) and logs exactly one WARNING without raising, and S2 adds no new runtime dependency.
